input.summary: State Customer's convenience notice in days and cap early termination charges at three months
input.comment: [Playbook] We have stated our convenience termination notice expressly as thirty (30) days' written notice and capped any early termination charge at three (3) months' charges, consistent with our fallback position that leaving on notice should not carry an open-ended penalty.

ops.oldText: a. providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and
ops.newText: a. providing at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice of such termination for convenience to IBM; and

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, capped at three (3) months' charges.
